'''R2-A3''' was an [[R2-series astromech droid]] that served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire]]. It was based out of the [[Great Temple|Rebel headquarters]] on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]] and flew alongside [[Red Two]] [[pilot]] [[Wedge Antilles]]. During the [[Battle of Yavin]], R2-A3 and Antilles flew together in a [[T-65B X-wing starfighter]], in which the Alliance fought against the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]] in the [[Yavin system]].

After initially engaging Imperial [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter]]s and [[turret]]s in order to draw fire from the [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber]]s of [[Gold Squadron]], Antilles and the [[droid]] ultimately ended up attempting an attack run on the [[Death Star]]'s vulnerable [[thermal exhaust port]]. Before they could complete the run, their [[X-wing starfighter]] was damaged and they were forced to retreat.

==Biography==
R2-A3 was the designation of an [[R2-series astromech droid]]<ref name="Hasbro" /> manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton]]<ref name="Manufacturer" /> that served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire]]. The [[droid]] was stationed as part of the [[Massassi Group]] of Rebels based out of the [[Great Temple]] on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]]. There, it served as part of the [[Rebel Alliance Starfighter Corps]]' [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Red Squadron]], flying alongside [[Rebel pilot]] [[Wedge Antilles]] as [[Red Two]].<ref name="ANH" />

[[File:R2-A3_and_Wedge.png|thumb|left|250px|R2-A3 flew with Wedge Antilles in the Battle of Yavin.]]
During the [[Battle of Yavin]], R2-A3 and Antilles flew in an [[T-65B X-wing starfighter]] when Red [[Squadron]] was scrambled alongside the [[BTL-A4 Y-wing assault starfighter/bomber]]s of [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Gold Squadron]] to attempt to destroy the Empire's [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station|Death Star]] [[superweapon]] in the [[Yavin system]]. Along with the rest of the squadron, the pair engaged [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter]]s and [[turret]]s in an attempt to draw fire so that the [[bomber]]s could make an attack run on the [[Death Star]]'s vulnerable [[thermal exhaust port]].<ref name="ANH" />

After most of Gold Squadron was destroyed, Red Squadron began attempting attack runs on the port. Antilles and R2-A3 began to make a run along the Death Star's [[meridian trench]] alongside pilots [[Luke Skywalker]] and [[Biggs Darklighter]], but were forced to retreat from the battle after the [[Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]] damaged their [[X-wing starfighter]]. Skywalker ultimately managed to launch a [[proton torpedo]] down the exhaust port and sucessfully destroyed the Death Star before it could fire on the Rebel base on Yavin 4.<ref name="ANH" />

==Characteristics==
R2-A3 had [[Color|red]] and white paneling and a black [[sensor]].<ref name="Hasbro" /> Like all R2 units, it stood 0.96 [[meter]]s (3[[Foot|ft]] 2in) tall.<ref name="AEYNTK:UE" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Wedge_ANH_cockpit_set_photo.jpg|250px|thumb|On-set photo of Wedge and R2-A3]]
R2-A3 first appeared in the [[1977]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']].<ref name="ANH" /> It can be more clearly seen in on-set photos than the actual film.<ref name="DroidSite">{{WebCite|url=https://www.angelfire.com/droid/astromechs/page10.html|text=Rebel Astromech Droids|work=Star Wars Astromech Droids site|archivedate=20081015064953}}</ref> In the current [[canon]], the droid was first identified on an action figure set from the ''[[Star Wars: The Black Series]]'' released in [[2018]] by [[Hasbro]]<ref name="Hasbro" /> The name originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was first revealed in [[2010]] by Hasbro in a Q&A regarding an action figure they had released of the droid.<ref name="Q&A">{{WebCite|url=http://www.toymania.com/news/messages/11894.shtml|text=February 2010 Hasbro Star Wars Q&A (Part Two)|archivedate=20190310053629}}</ref>
